papers.title: Neuronal FICD shapes motivated behavior through modulation of dopamine receptor dynamics
papers.translated_title: 神经元FICD通过调节多巴胺受体动力学塑造动机行为
papers.author: Weaver, K. J.
papers.summary: Motivated behaviors rely on dopaminergic signaling, which in turn depends on the correct folding and trafficking of receptors through the endoplasmic reticulum (ER). Within the ER, the AMPylase enzyme FICD acts as a molecular rheostat through its modification of the chaperone BiP, dynamically tuning the organelle's responsiveness to folding perturbations and cellular stress. While the biochemistry of FICD is well-established, its role in complex animal behavior remains poorly understood. Here, we identify FICD as a conserved contributor to the generation of motivated behavior. In Drosophila, pan-neuronal knockdown of dFic significantly reduces feeding, spontaneous locomotion, and reward-seeking behavior. These alterations occur without disrupting circadian architecture, motor capacity, or homeostatic hunger, indicating a specific loss of motivational drive. Depleting dFic within subsets of dopamine receptor-expressing (Dop1R1) neurons recapitulates these behavioral alterations. Transcriptomic profiling reveals that dFic depletion does not induce a canonical unfolded protein response, pointing to a specific post-transcriptional alteration rather than global ER stress. At the molecular level, dysregulated dFic alters the localization and abundance of Dop1R1. Finally, we demonstrate that this regulatory axis is evolutionarily conserved, as loss of FICD similarly diminishes motivated behaviors in C. elegans and mice. Together, these findings implicate FICD in the generation of motivated behavior and link dynamic control of ER proteostasis to dopamine-receptor maturation.
papers.translated_summary: 动机行为依赖于多巴胺能信号传导，而后者又取决于受体在内质网中的正确折叠和运输。在内质网中，AMPylase酶FICD通过修饰分子伴侣BiP充当分子变阻器，动态调节该细胞器对折叠扰动和细胞应激的响应能力。虽然FICD的生物化学特性已被充分确立，但其在复杂动物行为中的作用仍知之甚少。在此，我们确定FICD是动机行为产生的一个保守贡献者。在果蝇中，泛神经元敲低dFic显著减少了摄食、自发运动和奖赏寻求行为。这些改变的发生并未破坏昼夜节律结构、运动能力或稳态饥饿，表明动机驱力的特异性丧失。在多巴胺受体表达（Dop1R1）神经元亚群中耗竭dFic可重现这些行为改变。转录组分析显示，dFic耗竭并不诱导经典未折叠蛋白反应，指向特定的转录后改变而非全局性内质网应激。在分子水平上，dFic失调改变了Dop1R1的定位和丰度。最后，我们证明这一调控轴在进化上是保守的，因为FICD的缺失同样减弱了线虫和小鼠的动机行为。总之，这些发现将FICD与动机行为的产生联系起来，并将内质网蛋白质稳态的动态控制与多巴胺受体成熟相关联。

papers.title: Viral dispersal drives changes in population composition
papers.translated_title: 病毒扩散驱动种群组成变化
papers.author: Holmes, K. E.
papers.summary: In an acute viral infection, a small seeding population expands rapidly over several orders of magnitude, then declines. This vast population growth is accompanied by spatial expansion as infection spreads to new anatomical sites within the host. Evolutionary theory predicts that spatially expanding populations experience more extreme stochastic losses of genetic diversity than spatially unstructured populations. To test this prediction in the context of viral dynamics, we evaluated the impact of spatial expansion on viral population genetic structure and assessed how modulators of viral dispersal affected this structure. To this end, we developed a means of implementing the spatial expansion of influenza A virus in cell culture and applied it to a viral population carrying a diverse genetic barcode. Across this simplified cellular landscape, we found that spatial expansion produces a patchwork of distinct viral subpopulations. We then evaluated the consequences for population structure of two modulators of viral dispersal: extracellular viscosity and a common polymorphism in the viral attachment protein. Both physical constraint and viral phenotype altered the extent of genetic bottlenecking and spatial heterogeneity that developed during expansion, indicating that environmental features and viral traits that modulate dispersal also modulate viral population composition, diversity and evolution.
papers.translated_summary: 在急性病毒感染中，一个小的种子种群会在几个数量级上迅速扩增，然后下降。这种庞大的种群增长伴随着空间扩张，因为感染会扩散到宿主体内新的解剖部位。进化理论预测，空间扩张的种群比空间上无结构的种群经历更极端的遗传多样性随机丧失。为了在病毒动力学背景下检验这一预测，我们评估了空间扩张对病毒种群遗传结构的影响，并评估了病毒扩散调节因子如何影响这种结构。为此，我们开发了一种在细胞培养中实现甲型流感病毒空间扩张的方法，并将其应用于携带多样化遗传条形码的病毒种群。在这个简化的细胞景观中，我们发现空间扩张产生了由不同病毒亚群组成的拼凑格局。然后，我们评估了两种病毒扩散调节因子对种群结构的后果：细胞外黏度和病毒附着蛋白中的一种常见多态性。物理限制和病毒表型都改变了扩张过程中形成的遗传瓶颈程度和空间异质性，这表明调节扩散的环境特征和病毒性状也会调节病毒种群组成、多样性和进化。

papers.title: Reversible fixation of microbial cells for targeted genomics
papers.translated_title: 微生物细胞的可逆固定用于靶向基因组学
papers.author: Engelberts, J. P.
papers.summary: Phylogeny- or activity-based fluorescent labelling of microorganisms coupled with fluorescence activated cell sorting (FACS) is a powerful approach to rapidly isolate cells of interest from complex communities for targeted genomics. However, the method has not been widely adopted because standard paraformaldehyde or ethanol fixation procedures hamper nucleic acid recovery and/or long-term sample storage. Here, we present dithiobis(succinimidyl propionate) (DSP) as a reversible fixative for microbial cells that enables fluorescence imaging and DNA extraction and amplification for sequencing. DSP fixation is compatible with widely used fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) approaches and bioorthogonal non-canonical amino acid tagging, and can be applied to diverse sample types, where it consistently performed as well as paraformaldehyde. Furthermore, high-quality genomes were obtained from individual and multiple bacterial cells selectively extracted from complex samples using FISH-FACS. Thus, DSP is a dual-use fixative for microbiome imaging and sequencing, improving targeted microbial genomics.
papers.translated_summary: 基于系统发育或活性的微生物荧光标记结合荧光激活细胞分选（FACS）是一种从复杂群落中快速分离目标细胞进行靶向基因组学的强大方法。然而，由于标准的多聚甲醛或乙醇固定程序妨碍了核酸回收和/或长期样品保存，该方法尚未被广泛采用。在此，我们提出二硫代双（琥珀酰亚胺基丙酸酯）（DSP）作为一种可逆的微生物细胞固定剂，能够实现荧光成像以及用于测序的DNA提取和扩增。DSP固定与广泛使用的荧光原位杂交（FISH）方法及生物正交非经典氨基酸标记兼容，并可应用于多种样品类型，其表现始终与多聚甲醛相当。此外，利用FISH-FACS从复杂样品中选择性提取的单个和多个细菌细胞中获得了高质量基因组。因此，DSP是一种用于微生物组成像和测序的双用途固定剂，改进了靶向微生物基因组学。

papers.title: Birth synchronisation increases allonursing opportunities in free-ranging dogs
papers.translated_title: 出生同步增加了自由放养犬类的异亲哺乳机会
papers.author: Vanderheyden, M.
papers.summary: Over 50 years ago, the hypothesis emerged that co-resident women synchronise menstruation through pheromonal cues. This idea has persisted as a widespread narrative and has subsequently been extrapolated to other animals as well. Indeed, reproductive synchrony has many potential benefits, including creating allonursing opportunities and facilitating female mate choice. Nevertheless, little evidence exists of female vertebrates synchronising their oestrus beyond seasonal effects, through socially mediated cues. We analysed reproductive synchrony in free-ranging dogs, which combine weak, population-dependent reproductive seasonality with facultative cooperative breeding. Controlling for seasonality, we show that birth synchrony was higher among co-resident, maternally related females, suggesting synchronisation among individuals who are likely to cooperate. This was supported by our finding that birth synchrony and maternal kinship independently increased the probability and frequency of allonursing. Finally, preliminary evidence shows that oestrus synchrony decreased male monopolisation. These findings contribute to the debate on socially mediated reproductive synchronisation, suggesting that it may have mainly evolved because it facilitates cooperative breeding.
papers.translated_summary: 50多年前，有人提出假说，认为共同居住的女性通过信息素线索实现月经同步。这一观点作为一种广泛流传的叙事延续至今，并随后被外推到其他动物。确实，繁殖同步有许多潜在益处，包括创造异亲哺乳机会和促进雌性择偶。然而，除了季节性影响之外，几乎没有证据表明雌性脊椎动物会通过社会介导的线索同步其发情。我们分析了自由放养犬的繁殖同步，它们兼具弱的、依赖种群的繁殖季节性和兼性合作繁殖。在控制季节性后，我们发现，在共同居住、母系相关的雌性中，出生同步更高，这表明可能合作的个体之间存在同步。我们的发现支持了这一点：出生同步和母系亲缘关系独立地提高了异亲哺乳的概率和频率。最后，初步证据表明，发情同步降低了雄性垄断。这些发现为关于社会介导繁殖同步的争论作出了贡献，表明它可能主要是因为它促进合作繁殖而进化出来的。

papers.title: Do LLM Proposers Improve Budgeted Search for Ionizable Lipids?
papers.translated_title: LLM提议者是否改善了可电离脂质的预算搜索？
papers.author: Singh, H.
papers.summary: Efficient lipid design under limited experimental budgets is a central challenge in computational chemistry and drug discovery. We introduce LEAF (Lipid Evolutionary Adaptive Framework), a matched-budget protocol for testing whether language-model proposers improve combinatorial molecular search relative to classical baselines. The study uses a 30,044-candidate ionizable-lipid space, a frozen Gaussian-process oracle fitted to experimental potency labels, and a separate active-learning surrogate. Four language models evaluated over eight seeds and three splits show no significant improvement over genetic-algorithm or random-search baselines. For Llama 8B, 79.1% of acquisition-selected queries repeat previously evaluated archive members. Removing duplicates reduces the performance gap on some splits but increases proposal cost and can prevent budget exhaustion. Larger models reduce duplication without establishing superiority or equivalence. Exploratory scored prompts and stricter novelty controls yield positive median differences against the genetic algorithm, yet wide intervals and shared-seed dependence preclude stronger conclusions. A validated single-assay reanalysis preserves the chemotype-cold deficit at a smaller numerical scale, and exploratory expected hypervolume improvement does not reverse the result. Follow-up checks address whether proposers genuinely use injected evidence. These checks include a zero-shot leakage probe, rank-only and chain-of-thought-rationale prompts, a score-shuffle perturbation, an evidence-conflict probe, and a genuine reasoning-mode proposer. They show measurable engagement with supplied information without a corresponding performance gain. LEAF isolates proposal quality as the experimental variable and documents a concrete failure mode of zero-shot LLM proposers under controlled budgets.
papers.translated_summary: 在有限实验预算下进行高效脂质设计是计算化学和药物发现中的核心挑战。我们提出LEAF（脂质进化自适应框架），一种匹配预算协议，用于检验语言模型提议器相对于经典基线是否改善组合分子搜索。该研究使用一个包含30,044个候选物的可电离脂质空间、一个拟合实验效力标签的冻结高斯过程预言机，以及一个独立的主动学习代理模型。四个语言模型在八个随机种子和三种数据划分上评估，相对于遗传算法或随机搜索基线未显示出显著改善。对于Llama 8B，79.1%的采集选择查询重复了先前已评估的档案成员。去除重复可缩小某些划分上的性能差距，但增加提议成本，并可能阻止预算耗尽。更大的模型减少了重复，但未能确立优越性或等价性。探索性评分提示和更严格的新颖性控制相对于遗传算法产生了正的中位数差异，但宽区间和共享种子依赖性阻碍了更强的结论。一项经过验证的单测定再分析在较小的数值尺度上保留了化学型冷启动缺陷，而探索性期望超体积改进并未逆转该结果。后续检查探讨提议器是否真正使用了注入的证据。这些检查包括零样本泄漏探测、仅排名和思维链理由提示、分数打乱扰动、证据冲突探测，以及一个真正的推理模式提议器。它们显示出对提供信息的可测量参与，但没有相应的性能增益。LEAF将提议质量作为实验变量隔离出来，并记录了零样本LLM提议器在受控预算下的一个具体失败模式。

papers.title: BioMod: Biological Module Tokenization for Single-Cell Foundation Modeling
papers.translated_title: BioMod：用于单细胞基础建模的生物学模块标记化
papers.author: Meng, L.
papers.summary: Single-cell foundation models typically represent cells as flat sequences of individual genes, requiring higher-order biological organization to be inferred implicitly from sparse expression profiles. Similar to the evolution from character-level to semantic tokenization in natural language processing,we hypothesize that cellular states can be more efficiently represented using biologically meaningful intermediate units. Here we present BioMod, a 50-million-parameter single-cell foundation model that introduces biological modules as representation units between genes and cells. BioMod constructs an overlapping vocabulary of 660 biological modules derived from curated pathways and data-driven gene programs, replacing thousands of gene-level inputs with compact module representations. Pretrained on approximately 73 million human cells using high-ratio module masking with an asymmetric decoder, BioMod achieves state-of-the-art performance across cell-type annotation, zero-shot batch integration, perturbation-response prediction and drug-response forecasting while maintaining a compact architecture that enables efficient inference on a single GPU. Module-level analyses further demonstrate that BioMod captures biologically meaningful cellular programs and preserves pathway-level organization.
papers.translated_summary: 单细胞基础模型通常将细胞表示为单个基因的扁平序列，需要从稀疏表达谱中隐式推断更高阶的生物组织。类似于自然语言处理中从字符级到语义标记化的演变，我们假设细胞状态可以用具有生物学意义的中间单元更高效地表示。在此，我们提出BioMod，一个拥有5000万参数的单细胞基础模型，引入生物模块作为基因与细胞之间的表示单元。BioMod构建了一个包含660个生物模块的重叠词汇表，这些模块来源于精选通路和数据驱动的基因程序，用紧凑的模块表示替代了数千个基因级输入。BioMod在约7300万个人类细胞上预训练，采用高比例模块掩码和非对称解码器，在细胞类型注释、零样本批次整合、扰动响应预测和药物响应预测方面达到了最先进的性能，同时保持紧凑的架构，可在单块GPU上高效推理。模块级分析进一步表明，BioMod能够捕获具有生物学意义的细胞程序并保留通路级组织。

papers.title: HERO: A hierarchy-aware analysis pipeline for reducing and refining whole-brain atlas-mapped cellular datasets
papers.translated_title: HERO：一种用于减少和精炼全脑图谱映射细胞数据集的层级感知分析流程
papers.author: Shipman, A. L.
papers.summary: Advances in high-throughput mesoscale microscopy and machine learning-based image analysis pipelines have made unbiased whole-brain imaging widely accessible. However, translating the resulting atlas-mapped datasets into biologically meaningful results remains a substantial barrier owing to their sheer magnitude and complex hierarchical organization. Consequently, reporting structure and analysis methods vary widely across studies, undermining rigor and reproducibility. To address this, we developed a user-friendly data reduction workflow, HERO (Hierarchy-aware Expression Region Organization), designed to perform hierarchy-aware selection, refinement, ranking, and visualization of whole-brain cell detection datasets. The workflow is customizable to specific needs, requires minimal coding experience, and outputs transparent, curated results. HERO functions as a seamless plug-in within larger-scale whole-brain cell detection analysis pipelines, providing efficient, unbiased region selection to streamline subsequent statistical analyses and comparative evaluations. Although HERO is developed with mouse cell-detection datasets, it can be applied to any atlas-mapped dataset that contains hierarchical information. Here, we applied the HERO pipeline to example cell detection datasets containing afferent cells from the bed nucleus of the stria terminalis (BST) and the insular cortex (insula). HERO provided top projecting regions consistent with historical tracing studies for the BST (e.g., amygdalar and hypothalamic regions) and the insula (e.g., somatosensory, autonomic, and interoceptive regions). Furthermore, the refinement step of HERO provides additional enriched regions originally obscured in the primary ranked outputs, such as memory- and emotion-associated structures. With HEROs dynamic processing, we were able to identify top-projecting regions consistent with the literature and, additionally, find regions often obscured in these large datasets. In sum, HERO offers a standardized analysis workflow to reduce whole-brain cell-detection datasets, transforming raw regional cell counts into curated results and advancing the effectiveness, interpretability, and accessibility of whole-brain imaging in neuroscience.
papers.translated_summary: 高通量介观显微成像和基于机器学习的图像分析流程的进展，使无偏全脑成像得以广泛普及。然而，由于数据规模庞大且具有复杂的层级组织，将由此获得并映射到脑图谱的数据集转化为具有生物学意义的结果仍然存在重大障碍。因此，不同研究报告的结构和分析方法差异很大，削弱了严谨性和可重复性。为解决这一问题，我们开发了一种用户友好的数据降维工作流程HERO（层级感知表达区域组织），旨在对全脑细胞检测数据集进行层级感知的选择、精炼、排序和可视化。该工作流程可根据具体需求进行定制，所需编程经验极少，并能输出透明、经过整理的结果。HERO可作为更大规模全脑细胞检测分析流程中的无缝插件，提供高效、无偏的区域选择，以简化后续统计分析和比较评估。尽管HERO是针对小鼠细胞检测数据集开发的，但它可应用于任何包含层级信息的脑图谱映射数据集。在此，我们将HERO流程应用于示例细胞检测数据集，这些数据集包含来自终纹床核（BST）和岛叶皮层（insula）的传入细胞。HERO提供的顶级投射区域与BST（如杏仁核和下丘脑区域）和insula（如躯体感觉、自主和内感受区域）的历史示踪研究一致。此外，HERO的精炼步骤还提供了最初在主要排序输出中被掩盖的额外富集区域，例如与记忆和情绪相关的结构。通过HERO的动态处理，我们能够识别与文献一致的顶级投射区域，并额外发现这些大型数据集中常被掩盖的区域。总之，HERO提供了一种标准化分析流程，用于对全脑细胞检测数据集进行降维，将原始区域细胞计数转化为经过整理的结果，并提升神经科学中全脑成像的有效性、可解释性和可及性。

papers.title: Criticality-related dynamics accompany long-term functional decline in primary cortical MEA cultures
papers.translated_title: 关键性相关动力学伴随原代皮层MEA培养物的长期功能衰退
papers.author: Escobar, A.
papers.summary: Primary cortical neuron cultures are widely used to study network development and decline, but their long-term electrophysiological trajectories are poorly characterized. We used multi-electrode arrays to longitudinally monitor Wistar rat cortical cultures for up to ~730 days in vitro (DIV), combining activity measures with survival analysis and criticality metrics. Wells shared an early developmental phase, with mean firing rate peaking at 12-14 Hz around DIV 100-150, before diverging into two phenotypes: early-death wells, showing progressive loss of burst organization, longer inter-burst intervals, shorter bursts, and steep declines in active-electrode recruitment; and long-survival wells, which sustained organized bursting and measurable activity well beyond DIV 400, in some cases past DIV 700. Cox proportional-hazards modeling with FDR correction across thirteen candidate features identified burst duration, inter-burst interval, synchrony, mean firing rate, branching ratio, and Kappa index as significant predictors of time to network failure. Criticality metrics offered the most mechanistic insight: in early-death wells, branching ratio declined toward zero and Kappa index rose toward its upper bound as networks approached silencing. Beyond their average levels, the rate of change of branching ratio and Kappa index over recordings was the strongest correlate of survival time among all criticality metrics. Neuronal avalanche size and duration exponents and their scaling relation, remained consistent with scale-free dynamics in both phenotypes while networks were active, though avalanche occurrence rate declined progressively in early-death wells without reaching significance as an independent predictor. These results show that long-term network survival is not determined by firing rate alone, but by preserved burst organization, sustained electrode recruitment and near-critical propagation dynamics. This work offers one of the longest electrophysiological characterizations of rodent cortical cultures to date and identifies criticality-based metrics as promising tools for predicting network decline and evaluating interventions to preserve long-term neuronal function.
papers.translated_summary: 原代皮层神经元培养被广泛用于研究网络发育与衰退，但其长期电生理轨迹仍缺乏充分表征。我们使用多电极阵列对Wistar大鼠皮层培养物进行纵向监测，时间长达体外约730天（DIV），并将活动指标与生存分析和临界性指标相结合。各孔共享一个早期发育阶段，平均放电率在DIV 100–150左右达到峰值12–14 Hz，随后分化为两种表型：早期死亡孔，表现为爆发组织进行性丧失、爆发间期延长、爆发持续时间缩短以及活跃电极募集急剧下降；长期存活孔，则维持有组织的爆发和可测量活动远超DIV 400，部分甚至超过DIV 700。采用Cox比例风险模型并对十三项候选特征进行FDR校正后，发现爆发持续时间、爆发间期、同步性、平均放电率、分支比和Kappa指数是网络失效时间的显著预测因子。临界性指标提供了最具机制性的洞见：在早期死亡孔中，随着网络接近沉默，分支比降至趋近于零，而Kappa指数升至趋近其上限。除平均水平外，分支比和Kappa指数随记录的变化率是所有临界性指标中与生存时间相关性最强的指标。神经元雪崩大小和持续时间指数及其标度关系，在网络活跃期间与两种表型中的无标度动力学均保持一致，尽管早期死亡孔中雪崩发生率逐步下降，但作为独立预测因子未达到显著性。这些结果表明，长期网络存活并非仅由放电率决定，而是由保留的爆发组织、持续电极募集和接近临界的传播动力学决定。这项工作提供了迄今为止对啮齿动物皮层培养物最长的电生理表征之一，并确定基于临界性的指标是预测网络衰退和评估干预措施以维持长期神经元功能的有前景工具。

papers.title: Deciphering auditory neuroprogenitor stemness for large-scale neuronal screening
papers.translated_title: 解析听觉神经祖细胞的干性以实现大规模神经元筛选
papers.author: Rousset, F.
papers.summary: Sensorineural hearing loss can arise from damage to sensory hair cells, auditory neurons or their synaptic connections, with auditory neuropathy and cochlear synaptopathy highlighting the importance of neural integrity for hearing. The mammalian cochlea has limited capacity to regenerate lost auditory neurons. Understanding the molecular programs that sustain cochlear progenitor expansion and neurogenic competence could support neuronal regeneration and provide renewable models for auditory drug discovery. We previously established that WNT activation combined with dual SMAD inhibition (CHIR-DS) supports scalable expansion and neuronal differentiation of mouse auditory neuroprogenitors (ANPGs). Here, we characterize the transcriptional, chromatin and metabolic changes associated with the induced state. RNA-seq and ATAC-seq identified reduced Id1 and Id2 expression and increased accessibility at proneural basic helix-loop-helix motifs, alongside transcriptional enrichment of translation, mTOR and glucose-metabolism programs. Compared with growth-factor controls, CHIR-DS-treated ANPGs showed slight increase in glycolysis at early passage. However, after long-term expansion, both glycolysis and mitochondrial respiration were markedly enhanced. Human fetal ANPGs also responded to CHIR-DS with increased sphere growth and retained neural differentiation capacity, providing proof of concept beyond the mouse system. Finally, neurons derived from stemness-induced ANPGs (siANs) supported a 384-well reporter assay and a 2,560-compound pilot screen that nominated candidate neurite-outgrowth enhancers. Together, these findings validate the pathway basis of ANPG stemness induction, characterize the resulting molecular and metabolic state, and demonstrate human feasibility and a neuronal screening application.
papers.translated_summary: 感音神经性听力损失可由感觉毛细胞、听觉神经元或其突触连接的损伤引起，其中听觉神经病和耳蜗突触病凸显了神经完整性对听力的重要性。哺乳动物耳蜗再生丢失听觉神经元的能力有限。理解维持耳蜗祖细胞扩增和神经发生能力的分子程序，可支持神经元再生，并为听觉药物发现提供可再生的模型。我们此前已确定，WNT激活联合双重SMAD抑制（CHIR-DS）可支持小鼠听觉神经祖细胞（ANPGs）的可规模化扩增和神经元分化。在此，我们表征了与诱导状态相关的转录、染色质和代谢变化。RNA-seq和ATAC-seq发现Id1和Id2表达降低，前神经碱性螺旋-环-螺旋基序处可及性增加，同时翻译、mTOR和葡萄糖代谢程序的转录富集。与生长因子对照相比，CHIR-DS处理的ANPGs在早期传代时糖酵解略有增加。然而，在长期扩增后，糖酵解和线粒体呼吸均显著增强。人胎儿ANPGs也对CHIR-DS作出反应，表现为球体生长增加并保留神经分化能力，提供了超越小鼠系统的概念验证。最后，源自干性诱导ANPGs（siANs）的神经元支持384孔报告基因 assay 和2,560化合物初步筛选，提名了候选神经突生长增强剂。总之，这些发现验证了ANPG干性诱导的通路基础，表征了由此产生的分子和代谢状态，并展示了人类可行性和神经元筛选应用。

papers.title: A foundation model for brain organoid network dynamics uncovers intrinsic computation and convergent disease phenotypes
papers.translated_title: 脑类器官网络动力学的基座模型揭示了内在计算与汇聚性疾病表型
papers.author: Schweiger, H. E.
papers.summary: Brain organoids develop self-organizing neural networks that can be used to model neurodevelopment and disease. Here we introduce PULSE, a foundation model developed using over 900 hours of high-density microelectrode array recordings of in vitro and ex vivo neural tissue. We show that this single model can address two open questions: how disease-associated variants alter network development, and how naive circuits encode information. PULSE revealed accelerated network maturation in held-out human 16p11.2-deletion organoids. It also revealed a change in network coordination shared with SHANK3 deficiency. Because organoids develop without sensory input, they let us ask how circuits encode information before any representation is learned. Closed-loop control of a virtual inverted pendulum engaged existing spontaneous activity patterns rather than creating new ones. PULSE provides a common reference frame for neural circuits across genotypes, protocols and tasks.
papers.translated_summary: 脑类器官可发育形成自组织神经网络，可用于模拟神经发育和疾病。在此，我们介绍PULSE，这是一个利用超过900小时的高密度微电极阵列记录体外和离体神经组织所开发的基础模型。我们表明，这一单一模型可以解决两个未决问题：疾病相关变异如何改变网络发育，以及初始回路如何编码信息。PULSE揭示了留出的人16p11.2缺失类器官中网络成熟加速。它还揭示了与SHANK3缺陷共有的网络协调变化。由于类器官在没有感觉输入的情况下发育，它们使我们能够探究回路在任何表征被学习之前如何编码信息。对虚拟倒立摆的闭环控制调用了已有的自发活动模式，而不是创造新的模式。PULSE为跨基因型、方案和任务的神经回路提供了一个共同的参考框架。

papers.title: Contrasting Patterns of Cortical Volume Change in First-Episode Schizophrenia-Spectrum Psychosis
papers.translated_title: 首发精神分裂症谱系精神病中皮层体积变化的对比模式
papers.author: Spaniel, F.
papers.summary: **Importance** Average gray matter volume (GMV) loss in early psychosis may conceal clinically relevant differences in brain change. **Objective** To identify longitudinal GMV-change patterns, their cross-site correspondence, and clinical associations. **Design, Setting, and Participants** Prospective cohort with T1-weighted MRI acquired during 2011-2026 at 2 Czech sites; median follow-up, approximately 13 months. Participants were 222 patients with first-episode schizophrenia-spectrum psychosis and 178 healthy controls frequency-matched by site and baseline age. **Exposure** First-episode psychosis vs healthy control status. **Main Outcomes and Measures** Diagnosis-blind clustering by site of image-quality-corrected, subsequently annualized GMV change across 333 cortical parcels; longitudinal voxel-based morphometry (VBM); Global Assessment of Functioning and consensus 5-factor Positive and Negative Syndrome Scale negative-symptom scores. **Results** Among 400 participants (mean [SD] age, 28.2 [7.5] years), 208 (52.0%) were male. Each site independently yielded 3 clusters: C1 (near-stable GMV), C2 (pronounced decrease), and C3 (increase). Cross-site centroid correlations across 333 parcels were strong for C2 and C3 (Spearman rho = 0.865 and 0.861); C1 correlation was weak (rho = 0.138), as expected for near-zero profiles with little regional variation. C2/C3 correspondence supported pooling matched site-specific clusters for post hoc analyses. Pooled clusters contained 77 patients and 125 controls in C1, 66 patients and 16 controls in C2, and 79 patients and 37 controls in C3. Suffixes -P and -HC identify patient and control subgroups. To situate patient changes relative to controls, post hoc VBM revealed an unanticipated gradient of increasingly pronounced GMV reduction across C1-HC to C1-P to C2-P, prominently involving association cortex, and bilateral ventral temporal GMV increase in C3-P (familywise error-corrected P < .05). The opposite contrast along this ordering showed periventricular changes consistent with progressively greater ventricular enlargement. C2-P had the lowest mean follow-up functioning and highest mean negative-symptom severity (adjusted omnibus P = .005 and .02); clinical changes from baseline did not differ significantly among patient groups. **Conclusions and Relevance** Early GMV change in psychosis was not uniform but comprised two contrasting directions: a clinically relevant, control-anchored pattern of increasingly pronounced GMV loss involving default mode regions and a distinct, directionally opposing ventral temporal increase.
papers.translated_summary: 重要性 早期精神病中平均灰质体积（GMV）丢失可能掩盖了具有临床相关性的脑变化差异。目的 识别纵向GMV变化模式、其跨站点对应关系及临床关联。设计、设置和参与者 前瞻性队列，2011-2026年在2个捷克站点获取T1加权MRI；中位随访约13个月。参与者为222例首发精神分裂症谱系精神病患者和178名按站点和基线年龄频数匹配的健康对照。暴露 首发精神病与健康对照状态。主要结局和测量 按站点对图像质量校正后、随后年化的333个皮层分区的GMV变化进行诊断盲法聚类；纵向基于体素的形态测量学（VBM）；全球功能评估和共识5因子阳性与阴性症状量表阴性症状评分。结果 在400名参与者中（平均[SD]年龄，28.2[7.5]岁），208名（52.0%）为男性。每个站点独立产生3个聚类：C1（GMV接近稳定）、C2（显著下降）和C3（增加）。C2和C3在333个分区上的跨站点质心相关性很强（Spearman rho = 0.865和0.861）；C1相关性较弱（rho = 0.138），这符合接近零 profile 且区域变异很小的预期。C2/C3对应关系支持将匹配的站点特异性聚类合并用于事后分析。合并聚类中，C1包含77例患者和125名对照，C2包含66例患者和16名对照，C3包含79例患者和37名对照。后缀-P和-HC标识患者和对照亚组。为将患者变化相对于对照进行定位，事后VBM显示，从C1-HC到C1-P再到C2-P存在一个未预料到的、逐渐更明显的GMV减少梯度，主要涉及联合皮层，并且C3-P存在双侧腹侧颞叶GMV增加（familywise error校正P < .05）。沿此顺序的相反对比显示脑室周围变化，与逐渐加重的脑室扩大一致。C2-P的平均随访功能最低，平均阴性症状严重程度最高（校正omnibus P = .005和.02）；患者组间自基线的临床变化无显著差异。结论与意义 精神病早期GMV变化并非一致，而是包含两个相反方向：一个具有临床相关性、以对照为锚定的模式，表现为逐渐更明显的GMV丢失并涉及默认模式区域；以及一个不同的、方向相反的腹侧颞叶增加。

papers.title: Language eligibility criteria and enrolled racial and ethnic composition in US clinical trials: a cross-sectional study
papers.translated_title: 美国临床试验中的语言资格标准和入组种族及族裔构成：一项横断面研究
papers.author: Tolas, A.
papers.summary: BACKGROUND: Federal policy now requires sponsors to submit diversity action plans for clinical trials, yet the modifiable features of trial design associated with enrolled composition remain poorly characterized. English-language proficiency requirements are written into eligibility criteria and recorded as free text in a public registry, making them visible and, in principle, amenable to revision, but their relationship to enrolled composition has been examined only within single disease areas and in small samples of trials. We examined whether these requirements and documented language accommodation were associated with the racial and ethnic composition of enrolled participants. METHODS AND FINDINGS: We conducted a cross-sectional study of interventional trials registered on ClinicalTrials.gov with at least one US site and posted results, using a registry snapshot retrieved in October 2026. The primary cohort comprised the 44,487 trials with exclusively US sites, of which 21,924 (49.3%) reported baseline race and 17,434 (39.2%) reported baseline ethnicity with counts that reconciled with the posted denominator. Both exposures were classified from free-text eligibility criteria using regular expressions validated against independent physician review of 150 trials. For the English-language requirement classifier, sensitivity was 88.2% and specificity was 99.2%. The outcome was the trial-level proportion of enrolled participants in each category, analyzed using generalized linear models adjusted for intervention class, therapeutic area, sponsor, phase, enrollment, sites, start year, US Census region, and the population composition of the trial's site states. An English-language proficiency requirement appeared in 5,736 trials (12.9%); its prevalence rose from 7.4% of trials starting in 2010 to 26.2% in 2023 (odds ratio [OR] per decade 2.91, P<0.001), whereas documented accommodation, an eligibility statement allowing participation in a language other than English (Spanish in 99.9% of flagged trials), remained rare (788 trials, 1.8%). The requirement was associated with lower enrolled proportions of Asian (OR=0.85, 95% CI 0.77-0.93, P=0.001) and Hispanic/Latinx participants (OR=0.85, 95% CI 0.79-0.91, P<0.001), with no evidence of an association for White participants (OR=0.99, 95% CI 0.95-1.04, P=0.75). Documented accommodation was associated with a higher proportion of Hispanic/Latinx participants (OR=3.23, 95% CI 2.82-3.71, P<0.001). Geographic adjustment did not change the statistical significance of the requirement associations and attenuated the accommodation association. The main limitations were the cross-sectional design, which precludes causal inference; the restriction of enrollment analyses to trials reporting baseline demographics, which were more recent than those without such reporting; and possible misclassification of automatically classified exposures. CONCLUSIONS: English-language proficiency requirements became more than three times as common between 2010 and 2023 and were associated with lower enrolled proportions of Asian and Hispanic/Latinx participants. Less common documented language accommodation was associated with a higher enrolled proportion of Hispanic/Latinx participants. Because these criteria are investigator-written and publicly recorded, they may be a tractable target for improving enrollment equity, although whether revising them changes who enrolls requires prospective evaluation
papers.translated_summary: 背景：联邦政策现在要求申办方为临床试验提交多样性行动计划，但与入组构成相关的试验设计可修改特征仍鲜有刻画。英语语言能力要求被写入资格标准，并作为自由文本记录在公共注册库中，使其可见，并且原则上可修改，但其与入组构成的关系仅在单一疾病领域和小样本试验中受到考察。我们研究了这些要求以及有记录的语言便利措施是否与入组参与者的种族和族裔构成相关。方法和发现：我们对在ClinicalTrials.gov注册、至少有一个美国站点并已发布结果的干预性试验进行了横断面研究，使用2026年10月检索的注册库快照。主要队列包括44,487项仅设美国站点的试验，其中21,924项（49.3%）报告了基线种族，17,434项（39.2%）报告了基线族裔，且计数与已发布的分母相符。两项暴露均使用正则表达式从自由文本资格标准中分类，并针对150项试验的独立医生审查进行了验证。对于英语语言要求分类器，敏感性为88.2%，特异性为99.2%。结局为每个类别中入组参与者的试验层面比例，使用广义线性模型分析，并校正干预类别、治疗领域、申办方、分期、入组人数、站点、开始年份、美国人口普查区域以及试验站点所在州的人口构成。英语语言能力要求出现在5,736项试验中（12.9%）；其患病率从2010年开始的试验中的7.4%上升至2023年的26.2%（每十年比值比[OR]为2.91，P<0.001），而有记录的便利措施，即允许以英语以外语言参与的资格声明（在标记试验中99.9%为西班牙语），仍然罕见（788项试验，1.8%）。该要求与亚裔（OR=0.85，95% CI 0.77-0.93，P=0.001）和西班牙裔/拉丁裔参与者（OR=0.85，95% CI 0.79-0.91，P<0.001）入组比例较低相关，未发现与白人参与者相关的证据（OR=0.99，95% CI 0.95-1.04，P=0.75）。有记录的便利措施与西班牙裔/拉丁裔参与者比例较高相关（OR=3.23，95% CI 2.82-3.71，P<0.001）。地理校正未改变该要求相关性的统计学显著性，并减弱了便利措施相关性。主要局限性为横断面设计，无法进行因果推断；入组分析仅限于报告基线人口学特征的试验，而这些试验比未报告者更近；以及自动分类暴露可能存在错误分类。结论：英语语言能力要求在2010年至2023年间变得常见了三倍以上，并与亚裔和西班牙裔/拉丁裔参与者入组比例较低相关。较少见的有记录语言便利措施与西班牙裔/拉丁裔参与者入组比例较高相关。由于这些标准由研究者撰写并公开记录，它们可能是改善入组公平性的一个可处理目标，尽管修改这些标准是否会改变入组人群仍需前瞻性评估。

papers.title: Association of childhood experiences with wellbeing and flourishing outcomes in Indian adults: Evidence from the India Sample of the Global Flourishing Study (GFS)
papers.translated_title: 童年经历与印度成年人幸福感和繁荣结果的关联：来自全球繁荣研究（GFS）印度样本的证据
papers.author: Hou, Y.
papers.summary: Background: Childhood experiences contribute to health and wellbeing across the life course, yet research from low- and middle-income countries has largely focused on a few outcomes rather than broader patterns of adult wellbeing, behaviors, and social and financial circumstances. Methods: In this cross-sectional analysis, we used a nationally representative sample of adults in India (N = 12,765; aged [≥] 18 years) from the Global Flourishing Study (GFS) Wave 1 (2023) to examine associations between eight retrospectively reported childhood experience items, 45 adult outcomes, and two composite flourishing indices. Survey-weighted linear, logistic, and proportional-odds models adjusted for age, gender, education, and residential setting, with Bonferroni correction were used to assess associations and effect modification by gender. Findings: Although the breadth and strength of associations differed across childhood experiences, less favorable childhood experiences were generally associated with poorer wellbeing and flourishing, greater odds of adverse health outcomes, and reduced access to resources and safety in adult life. However, outcomes related to prosocial behaviors showed a different pattern: childhood abuse (physical or sexual) was associated with greater odds of volunteering (OR 1.31, 95% confidence interval or CI [1.13,1.51]), feeling like an outsider in one's family with greater odds of donating (OR 1.80, 95% CI [1.52,2.13]), volunteering (OR 1.53, 95% CI [1.28,1.82]), and helping a stranger (OR 1.49, 95% CI [1.27,1.74]). Associations were broadly similar between females and males, with little evidence of gender differences. Interpretation: Associations of childhood adversity with poorer health and increased prosocial behavior in adult life may reflect unmeasured social, cultural, or dispositional factors and heterogeneous life-course responses. Nevertheless, these findings support strengthening child-protection, financial assistance programs, and mental health services in India.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：童年经历对一生中的健康与福祉都有影响，但来自低收入和中等收入国家的研究大多只关注少数结局，而非成人福祉、行为以及社会和经济状况的更广泛模式。方法：在这项横断面分析中，我们使用了来自全球繁荣研究（GFS）第1波（2023年）的印度全国代表性成人样本（N = 12,765；年龄[≥]18岁），以检验八个回顾性报告的童年经历条目、45个成人结局以及两个综合繁荣指数之间的关联。使用调查加权的线性、逻辑和比例优势模型，并调整年龄、性别、教育和居住环境，采用Bonferroni校正来评估关联以及性别对关联的效应修饰。结果：尽管不同童年经历之间关联的广度和强度不同，但较不利的童年经历总体上与较差的福祉和繁荣、较高的不良健康结局几率以及成年生活中获得资源和安全的机会减少相关。然而，与亲社会行为相关的结局呈现出不同模式：童年虐待（身体或性）与更高的志愿服务几率相关（OR 1.31，95%置信区间或CI [1.13,1.51]），感觉自己在家中像外人的人与更高的捐赠几率相关（OR 1.80，95% CI [1.52,2.13]）、志愿服务几率相关（OR 1.53，95% CI [1.28,1.82]）以及帮助陌生人几率相关（OR 1.49，95% CI [1.27,1.74]）。女性与男性之间的关联大体相似，几乎没有证据表明存在性别差异。解释：童年逆境与成年生活中较差健康和增加亲社会行为的关联，可能反映了未测量的社会、文化或性情因素以及异质性的人生历程反应。尽管如此，这些发现支持在印度加强儿童保护、经济援助项目和心理健康服务。

papers.title: Vascular Remodelling in Idiopathic Nephrotic Syndrome with Administration of Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme Inhibitors and Angiotensin Receptor Blockers
papers.translated_title: 特发性肾病综合征中应用血管紧张素转换酶抑制剂和血管紧张素受体阻滞剂后的血管重塑
papers.author: Dimiati, H.
papers.summary: Background Pediatric nephrotic syndrome (NS) significantly increases cardiovascular risk, primarily through activation of the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS) and chronic inflammation. This study aimed to evaluate the relationship between serum aldosterone and interleukin 6 (IL-6) levels with carotid intima-media thickness (CIMT) in children with steroid-sensitive (SSNS) and steroid-resistant NS (SRNS), both before and after combined treatment with angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors (ACEI) and angiotensin receptor blockers (ARB). Materials and methods A prospective cohort study enrolled 32 children aged 2-18 years with idiopathic NS at Dr. Zainoel Abidin Hospital, Banda Aceh, Indonesia (May-June 2024). Participants received lisinopril (ACEI) or valsartan (ARB) for 12 weeks. Serum aldosterone was quantified via liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry, IL-6 via electrochemiluminescence immunoassay, and CIMT via high-resolution B-mode Doppler ultrasound. Data were analyzed using SPSS version 26.0, including Shapiro Wilk normality testing, Pearson/Spearman correlations, and multivariate linear regression (enter method, R2=0.022), with statistical significance set at p<0.05. Results CIMT decreased significantly post-treatment (0.13{+/-}0.04 cm to 0.06{+/-}0.01 cm; p<0.001). Serum aldosterone remained stable (5.15 to 4.0 ng/dL; p=0.933), as did IL-6 (3.5 pg/mL; p=0.156). Univariate analyses revealed weak correlations (aldosterone-CIMT: R2=0.075; IL-6-CIMT: R2=0.215). Multivariate regression (R2=0.022) identified SRNS as positively associated with CIMT change (p=0.047), while aldosterone and IL-6 showed no significant independent effects. Conclusion This study highlights that ACEI and ARB therapy improved CIMT regardless of steroid sensitivity, suggesting vascular benefits may occur through pathways independent of aldosterone and IL-6 modulation.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 儿童肾病综合征（NS）显著增加心血管风险，主要通过激活肾素-血管紧张素-醛固酮系统（RAAS）和慢性炎症。本研究旨在评估激素敏感型（SSNS）和激素耐药型NS（SRNS）患儿在接受血管紧张素转换酶抑制剂（ACEI）和血管紧张素受体阻滞剂（ARB）联合治疗前后，血清醛固酮和白细胞介素6（IL-6）水平与颈动脉内膜中层厚度（CIMT）的关系。材料与方法 一项前瞻性队列研究纳入32名2-18岁特发性NS患儿，地点为印度尼西亚班达亚齐Dr. Zainoel Abidin医院（2024年5月至6月）。参与者接受赖诺普利（ACEI）或缬沙坦（ARB）治疗12周。血清醛固酮通过液相色谱-串联质谱法定量，IL-6通过电化学发光免疫分析法测定，CIMT通过高分辨率B型多普勒超声测定。数据使用SPSS 26.0版进行分析，包括Shapiro Wilk正态性检验、Pearson/Spearman相关分析和多因素线性回归（进入法，R2=0.022），统计学显著性设定为p<0.05。结果 治疗后CIMT显著下降（0.13{+/-}0.04 cm降至0.06{+/-}0.01 cm；p<0.001）。血清醛固酮保持稳定（5.15至4.0 ng/dL；p=0.933），IL-6亦然（3.5 pg/mL；p=0.156）。单因素分析显示相关性较弱（醛固酮-CIMT：R2=0.075；IL-6-CIMT：R2=0.215）。多因素回归（R2=0.022）确定SRNS与CIMT变化呈正相关（p=0.047），而醛固酮和IL-6未显示显著的独立效应。结论 本研究强调，ACEI和ARB治疗改善了CIMT，与激素敏感性无关，提示血管获益可能通过独立于醛固酮和IL-6调节的通路发生。

papers.title: Atrial fibrillation begets atrial fibrillation - serum-driven amplification of atrial electrical instability
papers.translated_title: 心房颤动引发心房颤动——血清驱动的心房电不稳定性的放大
papers.author: Bögner, M.
papers.summary: Rationale: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is sustained by electrical triggers and atrial substrate, but whether AF itself generates circulating factors that acutely reinforce arrhythmogenesis is unknown. Objective: To determine whether rhythm-dependent serum bioactivity directly destabilizes atrial electrophysiology and to identify associated cellular mechanisms and circulating mediators. Methods and Results: Cardiac samples were obtained from patients with persistent atrial fibrillation (AF) during AF and after restoration of sinus rhythm (SR) using electrical cardioversion. In isolated Langendorff-perfused mouse hearts, AF serum increased the duration, frequency, and cumulative burden of spontaneous atrial depolarizations compared with paired control perfusate. In human induced pluripotent stem cell derived atrial cardiomyocytes, AF patient serum decreased Ca2-transient amplitudes without significant effect on kinetics or Ca2 spark activity. Moreover, AF serum reduced peak sodium current without materially altering voltage-dependent gating or paced action-potential properties. Data-independent acquisition proteomics identified rhythm-associated changes in extracellular-matrix, proteolytic, inflammatory, and signaling proteins, including MMP9, Ccathepsin G, and 14-3-3 family members. Targeted pathway perturbation differentially modified serum-induced Ca2 phenotypes, indicating context-dependent, multifactorial bioactivity. Serum-induced Ca2 responses were not associated with indices of atrial disease severity, including low-voltage substrate burden and left atrial pressure. Conclusions: Persistent AF is accompanied by rhythm-dependent circulating bioactivity that acutely promotes atrial electrical instability and Ca2-dependent trigger formation. These findings extend the concept that AF begets AF beyond tissue-intrinsic remodeling and identify a potentially reversible serum-mediated feed-forward mechanism linking rhythm status and circulating proteomic signals in an atrial substrate severity independent fashion. Keywords: atrial fibrillation; serum; atrial cardiomyopathy; calcium signaling; circulating factors; proteomics
papers.translated_summary: 理由：心房颤动（AF）由电触发因素和心房基质维持，但AF本身是否会产生循环因子从而急性增强心律失常发生，尚不清楚。目的：确定节律依赖性的血清生物活性是否直接破坏心房电生理稳定性，并识别相关的细胞机制和循环介质。方法与结果：从持续性心房颤动（AF）患者在AF期间以及使用电复律恢复窦性心律（SR）后获取心脏样本。在离体Langendorff灌注小鼠心脏中，与配对的对照灌注液相比，AF血清增加了自发性心房去极化的持续时间、频率和累积负荷。在人诱导多能干细胞来源的心房心肌细胞中，AF患者血清降低了Ca2瞬变振幅，而对动力学或Ca2火花活动无显著影响。此外，AF血清降低了峰值钠电流，而未实质性改变电压依赖性门控或起搏动作电位特性。数据非依赖性采集蛋白质组学识别出细胞外基质、蛋白水解、炎症和信号蛋白中与节律相关的变化，包括MMP9、Ccathepsin G和14-3-3家族成员。靶向通路扰动差异性修饰了血清诱导的Ca2表型，表明存在情境依赖性的多因素生物活性。血清诱导的Ca2反应与心房疾病严重程度指标无关，包括低电压基质负荷和左心房压力。结论：持续性AF伴随节律依赖性的循环生物活性，可急性促进心房电不稳定性和Ca2依赖性触发形成。这些发现将AF引发AF的概念扩展到组织内在重塑之外，并识别出一种潜在可逆的血清介导前馈机制，该机制以独立于心房基质严重程度的方式将节律状态与循环蛋白质组信号联系起来。关键词：心房颤动；血清；心房心肌病；钙信号；循环因子；蛋白质组学

papers.title: Maintenance Anesthetics and Postoperative Delirium in Older Adults Undergoing General Anesthesia: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-analysis of Randomized Trials
papers.translated_title: 老年患者全身麻醉中的维持麻醉药与术后谵妄：随机试验的系统评价和网络荟萃分析
papers.author: Miyake, T.
papers.summary: IntroductionPostoperative delirium (POD) is a frequent and serious complication in older surgical patients. The optimal maintenance anesthetic to prevent POD remains uncertain due to fragmented and inconsistent evidence. This systematic review and network meta-analysis will compare the effectiveness of remimazolam, propofol, sevoflurane, desflurane, isoflurane, xenon, and ciprofol, and establish an evidence-based ranking to guide clinical practice. Methods and AnalysisWe will systematically search CENTRAL, Embase, MEDLINE, Web of Science, and major trial registries without language or date restrictions. Two reviewers will independently screen studies, extract data, and assess risk of bias with the ROBUST-RCT tool. Random-effects network meta-analyses will estimate pooled risk ratio (RR) for dichotomous outcomes and mean difference (MD) or standardized mean difference (SMD) for continuous outcomes. Treatment rankings will be summarized using the surface under the cumulative ranking curve (SUCRA) values or P-scores. Certainty of evidence will be appraised with the Confidence in Network Meta-Analysis (CINeMA) framework. Ethics and disseminationEthical approval is not required as only published data will be analyzed. Results will be submitted to a peer-reviewed journal. The protocol was registered in PROSPERO (CRD420251118351; submitted 11 August 2025).
papers.translated_summary: 引言术后谵妄（POD）是老年手术患者中常见且严重的并发症。由于证据零散且不一致，预防POD的最佳维持麻醉药物仍不确定。本系统评价和网状Meta分析将比较瑞马唑仑、丙泊酚、七氟烷、地氟烷、异氟烷、氙气和环丙酚的有效性，并建立循证排序以指导临床实践。方法与分析我们将系统检索CENTRAL、Embase、MEDLINE、Web of Science和主要试验注册库，不限制语言或日期。两名评价者将独立筛选研究、提取数据，并使用ROBUST-RCT工具评估偏倚风险。随机效应网状Meta分析将估计二分类结局的合并风险比（RR）以及连续结局的平均差（MD）或标准化平均差（SMD）。治疗排序将使用累积排序曲线下面积（SUCRA）值或P分数进行总结。证据确定性将使用网状Meta分析置信度（CINeMA）框架进行评估。伦理与传播由于仅分析已发表数据，因此不需要伦理批准。结果将提交至同行评审期刊。该方案已在PROSPERO注册（CRD420251118351；2025年8月11日提交）。

papers.title: Implementation of early child development and maternal mental health care package for forcibly displaced Myanmar population in Bangladesh refugee camps: a process evaluation and cost-effectiveness study
papers.translated_title: 孟加拉国难民营中被迫流离失所的缅甸人群的早期儿童发展和孕产妇心理健康护理包实施：一项过程评估和成本效果研究
papers.author: Khan, N.
papers.summary: Abstract Background: The risk of developmental delays among infants in the refugee camps is high due to prolonged exposure to adverse situations such as poverty, violence, lack of access to basic necessities, safety, poor maternal mental health and inadequate access to healthcare. To reduce the risk of developmental delays, a contextualized early child development and maternal mental health care package, was implemented through enabling and engaging the refugee women as community-based care providers. Methods: The process evaluation study was conducted using a mix-method design to explore the acceptability, feasibility, appropriateness, adoption, and cost of the Early Child Development (ECD) and maternal mental health care package in refugee camps, by applying Proctor et al framework. Data on quantitative indicators was reviewed for 348 mother-child dyads in the intervention arm. Qualitative interviews were conducted with 12 mothers, 5 community health workers, and 2 members of the implementing research team. Incremental Cost-Effectiveness Ratio (ICER) was calculated using the healthcare provider perspective to estimate the incremental cost-effectiveness of the ECD care package in reducing proportion of children with two or more developmental delays. Results: Home-based delivery of counselling sessions was a key facilitator in ensuring the successful implementation of intervention. The delivery of intervention by modestly educated refugee women reduced cultural and language barriers and facilitated the home-based delivery of sessions. Mothers found the recommended activities feasible to do in routine as they were culturally appropriate, and did not require maternal literacy or additional resources. The intervention was cost-effective with an ICER of 63 USD in reducing the proportion of children with two or more developmental delays by one percentage point. Conclusion: Contextualized ECD and maternal health care package is a potentially replicable and scalable intervention for refugee healthcare systems. Keywords: Early child development, mental health, contextualised healthcare intervention, refugee camp, community-based providers
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 背景：难民营中婴儿发育迟缓的风险很高，原因是长期暴露于贫困、暴力、缺乏基本生活必需品、安全无保障、母亲心理健康状况不佳以及医疗保健服务获取不足等不利处境。为降低发育迟缓风险，通过赋能并吸纳难民妇女作为社区照护提供者，实施了一套情境化的儿童早期发展与母亲心理健康护理方案。 方法：采用混合方法设计开展过程评价研究，运用Proctor等人提出的框架，探讨难民营中儿童早期发展（ECD）与母亲心理健康护理方案的可接受性、可行性、适宜性、采纳情况及成本。对干预组348对母婴的定量指标数据进行了回顾。对12名母亲、5名社区卫生工作者和2名实施研究团队成员进行了定性访谈。采用医疗保健提供者视角计算增量成本效果比（ICER），以估算ECD护理方案在降低有两项及以上发育迟缓的儿童比例方面的增量成本效果。 结果：以家庭为基础提供咨询课程是确保干预成功实施的关键促进因素。由受教育程度不高的难民妇女实施干预，减少了文化和语言障碍，并促进了课程的家庭化提供。母亲们认为所推荐的活动在日常中可行，因为这些活动符合文化习惯，且不要求母亲具备识字能力或额外资源。该干预具有成本效果，ICER为63美元，可使有两项及以上发育迟缓的儿童比例降低一个百分点。 结论：情境化的ECD与母亲健康护理方案是一种对难民医疗保健系统具有潜在可复制性和可扩展性的干预措施。 关键词：儿童早期发展，心理健康，情境化医疗保健干预，难民营，社区照护提供者

papers.title: A calibration pipeline for controlled ocular photostimulation with consumer see-through extended-reality glasses
papers.translated_title: 用于受控眼部光刺激的校准流程，采用消费级透视扩展现实眼镜
papers.author: Gaidica, M.
papers.summary: Consumer extended-reality (XR) glasses could provide controlled ocular light exposure, but their settings do not specify the light delivered at the eye. We developed and validated a calibration pipeline linking display control, corneal-plane spectroradiometry, settings-to-exposure modeling, and rendered application content for a see-through binocular micro-OLED display (VITURE Luma Ultra). Automated measurements characterized color channels, digital codes, hardware brightness levels, and duty-cycle settings across repeated fittings on a phantom head. The blue primary peaked at 459 nm with no resolved spectral shift across intensity settings. Blue melanopic equivalent daylight illuminance (EDI) ranged from 14.7 to 252 lx across hardware brightness levels, while full white delivered 269 lx melanopic EDI at its highest usable setting, exceeding the 250 lx daytime recommendation for healthy adults. A model calibrated on separate sessions predicted melanopic EDI for held-out codes, brightness levels, and color mixtures with a mean absolute percentage error of 3.4% (4.5% for photopic illuminance), allowing exposure to be estimated from logged display settings without remeasuring each uniform stimulus. Rendered application frames revealed position- and illuminated-area-dependent exposure; a spatial correction derived from an independent display grid accounted for these effects and closely reproduced measured frame exposure. Together, these results establish a reusable workflow for converting see-through XR hardware into a quantitatively specified ocular-light platform.
papers.translated_summary: 消费级扩展现实（XR）眼镜可以提供受控的眼部光照暴露，但其设置并未标明实际到达眼睛的光量。我们开发并验证了一套校准流程，将显示控制、角膜平面光谱辐射测量、设置到暴露的建模以及渲染的应用内容联系起来，针对一款透视双目微型OLED显示器（VITURE Luma Ultra）。自动化测量在仿真头部上通过重复佩戴，表征了颜色通道、数字代码、硬件亮度级别和占空比设置。蓝色原色峰值位于459 nm，在不同强度设置下未分辨出光谱偏移。蓝色褪黑素等效日光光照度（EDI）在硬件亮度级别范围内为14.7至252 lx，而全白在其最高可用设置下提供269 lx褪黑素EDI，超过了健康成年人250 lx的日间推荐值。在单独会话上校准的模型对留出代码、亮度级别和颜色混合预测褪黑素EDI，平均绝对百分比误差为3.4%（明视觉光照度为4.5%），从而可以从记录的显示设置估计暴露，而无需重新测量每个均匀刺激。渲染的应用帧揭示了依赖于位置和照明面积的暴露；从独立显示网格导出的空间校正解释了这些效应，并密切再现了测量的帧暴露。总之，这些结果建立了一套可重复的工作流程，用于将透视XR硬件转换为定量指定的眼部光照平台。

papers.title: Can GPT Be Used as an Alternative Prediction Model to Traditional Machine Learning and Neural Networks on Low-Volume Clinical Data?
papers.translated_title: GPT能否作为低容量临床数据上传统机器学习和神经网络的替代预测模型？
papers.author: Bin Akter, S.
papers.summary: Background and Objective: Early and reliable disease prediction from structured clinical data remains challenging when datasets are small, highly imbalanced, and contain limited positive disease cases. Conventional machine learning (ML) and deep learning approaches often struggle to capture clinically meaningful relationships under such low-data representation conditions due to weak statistical associations between features and prediction targets. This study proposes a clinically grounded GPT2-based table-to-text framework for disease prediction using structured healthcare datasets, motivated by the contextual reasoning capability of GPT models to better capture clinically meaningful relationships when statistical learning alone becomes insufficient due to limited data availability. Methods & Materials: Structured clinical records were transformed into physician-style textual descriptions and enriched through GPT4-generated medical paraphrasing to improve minority-class representation while preserving clinical meaning. Both the original and generated clinical texts were used to fine-tune a GPT2 model across four public healthcare datasets, including heart disease, heart failure, chronic kidney disease, and thyroid cancer recurrence. Gradient-based explainable AI analysis was additionally incorporated to identify clinically important features influencing prediction outcomes. Results: The proposed framework demonstrated consistently strong predictive performance with average precision, specificity, sensitivity, and F1-score of 0.96, 0.97, 0.96, and 0.96, respectively. The model achieved improved sensitivity, stronger generalization, and more stable predictive behavior compared with traditional ML, deep learning, transformer-based, and GAN-augmented approaches. Importantly, the framework consistently emphasized clinically meaningful variables even under severe class imbalance where conventional ML and neural network models often struggled. Conclusions: The proposed GPT2-based table-to-text framework provides a practical and clinically interpretable approach for disease prediction from limited structured healthcare data. By integrating contextual clinical reasoning with explainable prediction mechanisms, the framework demonstrates strong potential for early risk detection, transparent clinical decision support, and reliable deployment in real-world low-resource healthcare environments.
papers.translated_summary: 背景与目标：当数据集规模小、高度不平衡且阳性疾病病例有限时，从结构化临床数据中进行早期且可靠的疾病预测仍然具有挑战性。传统的机器学习（ML）和深度学习方法在此类低数据表征条件下，往往因特征与预测目标之间统计关联较弱，而难以捕捉具有临床意义的关联。本研究提出了一种基于GPT2的、具有临床基础的表格到文本框架，用于利用结构化医疗数据集进行疾病预测，其动机在于GPT模型的上下文推理能力，当由于数据有限而仅靠统计学习不足时，能够更好地捕捉具有临床意义的关联。方法与材料：将结构化临床记录转换为医生风格的文本描述，并通过GPT4生成的医学改写进行丰富，以改善少数类表征，同时保留临床意义。原始和生成的临床文本均用于在四个公共医疗数据集上微调GPT2模型，包括心脏病、心力衰竭、慢性肾病和甲状腺癌复发。此外还引入了基于梯度的可解释AI分析，以识别影响预测结果的临床重要特征。结果：所提出的框架表现出持续强劲的预测性能，平均精确率、特异性、敏感性和F1分数分别为0.96、0.97、0.96和0.96。与传统ML、深度学习、基于Transformer以及GAN增强方法相比，该模型实现了更高的敏感性、更强的泛化能力和更稳定的预测行为。重要的是，即使在传统ML和神经网络模型常常难以应对的严重类别不平衡条件下，该框架仍持续强调具有临床意义的变量。结论：所提出的基于GPT2的表格到文本框架为从有限的结构化医疗数据进行疾病预测提供了一种实用且具有临床可解释性的方法。通过将上下文临床推理与可解释预测机制相结合，该框架在早期风险检测、透明临床决策支持以及在真实世界低资源医疗环境中的可靠部署方面展现出强大潜力。

papers.title: Strong Protein Responses to Acute Infection Control General Post-Viral Sequelae and SARS-CoV-2-specific Neurocognitive Sequelae
papers.translated_title: 强蛋白反应对急性感染控制一般病毒后遗症和SARS-CoV-2特异性神经认知后遗症
papers.author: Liou, T. G.
papers.summary: After serious infections, many survivors fully recover while others face persistent symptoms including neurocognitive dysfunction, cardiopulmonary instabilities and disabling fatigue, classified broadly as Post-Acute Infection Syndromes (PAIS). Post-Acute Sequelae of COVID19 (PASC) is one special case. To test whether acute infection initiates PAIS, we analyzed proteins in 173 saliva samples collected during severe respiratory viral infections and tracked patient outcomes for five years. We discovered 44 proteins, all derived from interferon stimulated genes, that respond strongly to acute infection. Rates of post-acute syndromes were similar regardless of infection, but the types of Sequelae differed by virus. High expression of 19 proteins predict low General Sequelae rates across all viruses. High expression of 23 overlapping proteins predict low Neurocognitive Sequelae rates only with SARS-CoV-2 infections. We propose that low expressions of these proteins, which control viral replication, innate immunity, and secondary autoimmunity, combine to precipitate PAIS and PASC.
papers.translated_summary: 严重感染后，许多幸存者完全康复，而另一些人则面临持续症状，包括神经认知功能障碍、心肺不稳定和致残性疲劳，这些被广泛归类为急性感染后综合征（PAIS）。COVID-19急性后遗症（PASC）是一个特殊案例。为了检验急性感染是否引发PAIS，我们分析了在严重呼吸道病毒感染期间收集的173份唾液样本中的蛋白质，并追踪了患者五年的结局。我们发现了44种蛋白质，全部来源于干扰素刺激基因，它们对急性感染有强烈反应。无论感染何种病毒，急性后综合征的发生率相似，但后遗症的类型因病毒而异。19种蛋白质的高表达预测所有病毒的一般后遗症发生率低。23种重叠蛋白质的高表达仅预测SARS-CoV-2感染的神经认知后遗症发生率低。我们提出，这些控制病毒复制、先天免疫和继发性自身免疫的蛋白质的低表达共同促成了PAIS和PASC。
